digest.component_or_area: review-bot comment-added trigger and retrigger eligibility
propositions: A Gerrit comment containing 'recheck-review' must trigger a re-review of the current patchset only if the current LLM-Review -1 tag is a coverage-gap reason or infrastructure failure, not a real finding
The eligibility gate must parse the bot's persisted message tag from Gerrit's ChangeMessageInfo, strip in-tag merge-change suffix, classify the stem, and refuse ONLY 'BLOCK — finding' variants
On refusal of a finding-BLOCK re-trigger, post a message comment (no vote/labels key) explaining the finding must be fixed by amendment and emit RETRIGGER_REFUSED
On acceptance of a coverage-gap re-trigger, reset the dedup attempts budget, enqueue with _rebar_force marker, post a reply, and emit RETRIGGER_ACCEPTED
The comment-added event must be added to webhooks.config and requires operator re-run of service-user.sh to activate
The /rerun operator endpoint must reset the attempts budget before enqueueing (harmonized with this ticket's manual trigger)
